evidence.title: Bind authoritative Search+Telemetry owners to read-only Event Inspection HTTP
evidence.goal: Offer an embeddable first-party HTTP handler returning the canonical CAP-INV-004 projection to the existing browser transport shape, only after independently server-verified session, Search Job selection and telemetry/raw/rendered authorization.
outputs: New embeddable authorized HTTP handler composing distinct SessionResolver, SearchOwner, TelemetryOwner and existing eventinspection.Project
Server response compatible with JS Inspector normalization: lowerCamel source/parser/enrichments; independent raw/rendered variants
HTTP httptest security matrix including host spoof, source redaction, denied raw, malformed requests, wrong Event and partial stale provenance
Exact-HEAD cross-platform CI evidence, with explicit exclusion of real host and production
Separate registered host boundary with explicit local-only Go dependency on immutable event-inspection-runtime; on-demand benchmark target measures ONLY the upstream in-process projector; no HTTP SLO
MANDATORY measured security adapter for event-inspection-http-host-runtime: new host Go security coverage and independently executed Search authorization/Tenant isolation tests
Engineering unit tests assert all nine explicitly registered runtime security evidence adapters, including the new HTTP host; existing mandatory adapters unchanged
On-demand deep load target executes actual Go httptest BenchmarkAuthorizedInspectionHTTP and reports measured ops/sec and allocation B/op, not fabricated peak heap or network p95.
acceptance_tests: Positive real HTTP request passes server-source authorization chain and returns browser-compatible read-only projection
Denial at Search stage never invokes Telemetry owner; owner/identity mismatch yields generic denied and zero protected bytes
Raw and rendered independent; denied raw causes zero leakage of source-owned raw-derived secret
Invalid Event origin/provenance, malformed/oversize JSON, unsupported method/content-type fail closed
Go race/test/vet and host coverage >=90% on exact commit; full adaptive engineering checks required separately
Global CHK-SECURITY-TESTS must measure new host coverage above unchanged mandatory 90% changed-critical floor and execute both host negative tests

rules: Go httptest exercises the actual handler, session/Search/Telemetry
Tested providers are synthetic host stubs; this does not supply
